description: On the bed in front of you there’s a round white plastic base with a tall curved upright piece already attached, and a separate white rectangular piece lying nearby. The left hand reaches forward to hold the round base steady as a left-hand object, while the right hand picks up the rectangular piece as a right-hand object, lifts it up, and lowers it into the open slot on the base next to the existing upright, adjusting its angle and pressing it down to fit.
